subject: Next steps: Pilot scope & model shortlist for LumiTech + Iberia locales
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Satoshi Yamada <satoshi.yamada@lumitech.jp>, Ana Silva <ana@iberiatech.pt>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: Pilot scope & model shortlist for LumiTech + Iberia locales

Hi Satoshi / Ana —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and clear next steps so we can get the pilot moving: 

What you told us:
- Primary use: in-product help + answer retrieval for e-comm checkout flows in Japanese, Portuguese (PT-PT), and Spanish (ES-ES).
- Acceptable latency: 150–250ms 95th for interactive flows.
- Quality bar: automated F1 >= 0.82 on intent/rerank tests; human-rating > 4.2/5 on a 200-sample rubric.
- Data concerns: sample PII redaction required before we ingest training prompts; data residency preference for EU for Iberia traffic.

Redwood model shortlist / initial recs (for the pilot):
1) Llama-3-13B-Chat (quantized int8, preference) — strong cross-lingual reasoning, good for longer context.
2) Mistral-7B-Instruct (float16) — lower cost path; recommend for latency-sensitive endpoints.
3) Redwood-EU-6B (locale-tuned) — small-footprint variant we suggest A/B testing for EU Portuguese/Spanish to catch regional idioms.

Why these: we matched your throughput/latency profile from the call and picked one higher-capacity generalist (13B), a cost-focused 7B candidate, and a locale-tuned small model to compare sociolinguistic fit in Iberia. We'll run evaluation sweeps across your prompt set + our standard multilingual benchmark.

Attachments & links I shared:
- pilot_scope_v1.pdf (scope, timeline, success criteria) [Attachment]
- prompt-set_lumi_eu_apac_v2.jsonl (seed prompts + annotation guidelines) [Attachment]
- benchmark_summary_20261107.csv (baseline scores from our public suites + similar customers) [Attachment]
- Eval dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/evals/benchmarks/lumi-2026 (read-only view)
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/3421

Immediate asks from us (to keep timeline tight):
1) Please send a small sample (up to 1,000 records) of real queries and expected outputs (redacted) by EOD Tue Nov 10. We only need enough to seed the first round of model fit metrics.
2) Confirm whether Iberia traffic must stay in EU-only infra (we can provision a VPC-resident inference pool).
3) Any additional compliance artifacts (current SOC2 report or auditor) you can share now will speed security review.

Proposed pilot timeline (2–3 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, sample data ingest, test prompt pass, configure routes.
- Week 1: run automated evals + 1:1 human spot-checks (200 samples).
- Week 2: A/B live testing behind feature flag; cost/latency analysis + decision checkpoint.

Next steps:
- If you agree, Neha will set up a short kickoff on Monday Nov 9 (30 min) to align engineers and share access.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pilot_scope_v1.pdf]

-----
From: Satoshi Yamada <satoshi.yamada@lumitech.jp>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ana Silva <ana@iberiatech.pt>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 18:48:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Next steps: Pilot scope & model shortlist for LumiTech + Iberia locales

Priya —

Thanks for the concise plan. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Tokenization / segmentation in Japanese: our tickets indicate some hallucinations around contract clauses when using models with suboptimal tokenizers. Can you confirm the tokenizer variant you’ll use for the Llama-3-13B run?
- Fallback strategy: for latency spikes, can we auto-fall back to the Mistral-7B route with capped context? We need graceful degradation.
- Data residency: for Iberia traffic, EU-only is a hard requirement — we cannot route that data outside EU regions.

Also, we cannot share any live PII examples; we will provide fully redacted samples. Expect the sample bundle by Tue.

—Satoshi
Satoshi Yamada
Localization Lead | LumiTech

Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: Pilot scope & model shortlist for LumiTech + Iberia locales

Hi Satoshi / Ana —

Quick answers to Satoshi's points: 
- Tokenizer: for Llama-3-13B we will run with the updated SentencePiece variant that we use in our cross-lingual pipeline (v2.1); it reduces segmentation mismatch for Japanese and handles emoji/half-width characters more robustly. We'll include a short test of edge cases in the first eval run.
- Fallback: yes — we can configure smart routing so that if 95th percentile latency crosses 250ms for the 13B route, traffic is routed automatically to the Mistral-7B path with a truncated context policy. We'll surface metrics in the console and can add a webhook to notify your SRE team.
- EU residency: noted. We'll provision the Iberia-facing endpoints in our eu-west region and pin storage/telemetry to EU-only.

Ben, Priya: can we list the pilot kickoff windows Monday 9–11am or 2–4pm (PST)?

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Exec, Enterprise | Redwood Inference

Thanks — couple of procurement/compliance items: 
- We need confirmation of SOC2 Type II and an ILM/audit log retention policy (minimum 12 months) for any EU-hosted telemetry. Can you point me to those docs?
- On the model shortlist: will the Redwood-EU-6B variant have Portuguese (PT-PT) fine-tuning, or is it trained on PT-BR? PT-BR drifts are problematic for our UI copy.

We will attend the Monday kickoff — prefer 2pm PST (works best for Lisbon and Tokyo).

Best,
Ana Silva
Product Lead, Iberia | IberiaTech (embedded at LumiTech pilot)

Hi all —

Great — confirmed notes & next steps: 
- Kickoff: Mon Nov 9, 2026 at 14:00 PST / Tue Nov 10 01:00 JST / Mon 22:00 UTC. Invite coming from Neha.
- Action owners:
  - LumiTech: provide redacted sample bundle (Satoshi) — due Tue Nov 10
  - Redwood: run tokenizer edge-case sweep + initial evals (Priya & Ben) — results Weds Nov 11
  - Security docs: SOC2 Type II + retention policy (Neha) — delivery Tue Nov 10 EOD

If anything changes, flag it in this thread. Looking forward to kickoff.

Cheers,
Priya
